set.body: Parent AC6-7. Integrate requests into MappingPipeline Run/Batch and versioned additive MappingExchange, contextual codecs/view and ordinary workspace producer. Bind member,timing/exposure,projection,axis/occurrence,allocation,query/grid identity. Retain failed/missing timing denominators. Imported workspace JSON retains claims and never recreates live mapping authority. Public CLI and independent Python Fraction/grid reader cover narrow/broad/multimodal/repeated/disjoint/point/untimed/external/failed cases, both paired members, foreign/rehashed corruption and lossy >2^53 refusal. Exact producer/schema/generator/fixture/known-answer/receipt handoff to Atlas; browser completion remains separate consumer responsibility. No empirical efficacy claim. Parent closes only with all 3 children and required gates/review.
set.title: [temporal] Paired temporal facade exchange and producer handoff
